      subroutine ggZZcapture(label,h34,h56,j1,j2,j3,j4,j5,j6,
     & amp0,amp2,amp4)
      use types
c--- This is called from within the coefficient-computing routines;
c--- captures m^0, m^2 and m^4 parts of the coefficient and stores
c--- in a common block
      use constants_mod
      use ZZclabels_mod
      use ZZdlabels_mod
      use first_mod
      use ggZZ_mod
      implicit none
      integer:: imt0,imt2,imt4,imp,ipp,h34,h56,j1,j2,j3,j4,j5,j6,
     & htag,ltag,itag
      complex(dp):: amp0,amp2,amp4
      character*(*) label
      parameter(imt0=1,imt2=2,imt4=3)
      parameter(ipp=1,imp=2)
!      common/ggZZcaptureres/res
!!$omp threadprivate(/ggZZcaptureres/)

      if (first) then
        res(:,:,:,:)=czip
        first=.false.
      endif

      htag=-1

c      write(6,*) 'label=',label

c--- Canonical permutation:  1 2 3 4 5 6
      if (   (j1 == 1) .and. (j2 == 2) .and. (j3 == 3)
     & .and. (j4 == 4) .and. (j5 == 5) .and. (j6 == 6) ) then
        if ((trim(label)=='1x2').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1)) then
          htag=imp
          ltag=3
          itag=c1_2
        endif
        if ((trim(label)=='1x2pp').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1)) then
          htag=ipp
          ltag=3
          itag=c1_2
        endif
        if ((trim(label)=='1x34').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1)) then
          htag=imp
          ltag=3
          itag=c1_34
        endif
        if ((trim(label)=='1x34pp').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1))then
          htag=ipp
          ltag=3
          itag=c1_34
        endif
        if ((trim(label)=='12x34').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1)) then
          htag=imp
          ltag=3
          itag=c12_34
        endif
        if ((trim(label)=='12x34pp').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1))
     &    then
          htag=ipp
          ltag=3
          itag=c12_34
        endif
        if ((trim(label)=='1x34x2mp').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1))
     &    then
          htag=imp
          ltag=4
          itag=d1_34_2
        endif
        if ((trim(label)=='1x34x2pp').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1))
     &    then
          htag=ipp
          ltag=4
          itag=d1_34_2
        endif
        if ((trim(label)=='2x1x34pp').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1))
     &    then
          htag=ipp
          ltag=4
          itag=d2_1_34
        endif
        if ((trim(label)=='2x1x34').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1))then
          htag=imp
          ltag=4
          itag=d2_1_34
        endif
        if ((trim(label)=='d62x1x34').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1))
     &    then
          htag=imp
          ltag=4
          itag=d6_2_1_34
        endif
        if ((label(1:5)=='bubmp').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1))
     &    then
          htag=imp
          ltag=2
          itag=ichar(label(6:6))-ichar('0')
        endif
        if ((label(1:5)=='bubpp').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1))
     &    then
          htag=ipp
          ltag=2
          itag=ichar(label(6:6))-ichar('0')
        endif
      endif

c--- Permute 1 and 2:  2 1 3 4 5 6
      if (   (j1 == 2) .and. (j2 == 1) .and. (j3 == 3)
     & .and. (j4 == 4) .and. (j5 == 5) .and. (j6 == 6) ) then
        if ((trim(label)=='1x34').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1)) then
          htag=imp
          ltag=3
          itag=c2_34
          if (amp0  /=  czip) amp0=conjg(amp0)
          if (amp2  /=  czip) amp2=conjg(amp2)
          if (amp4  /=  czip) amp4=conjg(amp4)
        endif
        if ((trim(label)=='1x34pp').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1))then
          htag=ipp
          ltag=3
          itag=c2_34
          if (amp0  /=  czip) amp0=conjg(amp0)
          if (amp2  /=  czip) amp2=conjg(amp2)
          if (amp4  /=  czip) amp4=conjg(amp4)
        endif
        if ((trim(label)=='2x1x34').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1))then
          htag=imp
          ltag=4
          itag=d1_2_34
          if (amp0  /=  czip) amp0=conjg(amp0)
          if (amp2  /=  czip) amp2=conjg(amp2)
          if (amp4  /=  czip) amp4=conjg(amp4)
        endif
        if ((trim(label)=='d62x1x34').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1))
     &    then
          htag=imp
          ltag=4
          itag=d6_1_2_34
          if (amp0  /=  czip) amp0=conjg(amp0)
          if (amp2  /=  czip) amp2=conjg(amp2)
          if (amp4  /=  czip) amp4=conjg(amp4)
        endif
      endif

c--- Permute 3,4 and 5,6:  1 2 5 6 3 4
      if (   (j1 == 1) .and. (j2 == 2) .and. (j3 == 5)
     & .and. (j4 == 6) .and. (j5 == 3) .and. (j6 == 4) ) then
        if ((trim(label)=='1x34').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1)) then
          htag=imp
          ltag=3
          itag=c1_56
        endif
        if ((trim(label)=='1x34pp').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1))then
          htag=ipp
          ltag=3
          itag=c1_56
        endif
        if ((trim(label)=='2x1x34pp').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1))
     &    then
          htag=ipp
          ltag=4
          itag=d1_2_34
        endif
      endif

c--- Permute 1,3,4 and 2,5,6:  2 1 3 4 5 6
      if (   (j1 == 2) .and. (j2 == 1) .and. (j3 == 5)
     & .and. (j4 == 6) .and. (j5 == 3) .and. (j6 == 4) ) then
        if ((trim(label)=='1x34').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1)) then
          htag=imp
          ltag=3
          itag=c2_56
          if (amp0  /=  czip) amp0=conjg(amp0)
          if (amp2  /=  czip) amp2=conjg(amp2)
          if (amp4  /=  czip) amp4=conjg(amp4)
        endif
        if ((trim(label)=='1x34pp').and.(h34==1).and.(h56==1))then
          htag=ipp
          ltag=3
          itag=c2_56
          if (amp0  /=  czip) amp0=conjg(amp0)
          if (amp2  /=  czip) amp2=conjg(amp2)
          if (amp4  /=  czip) amp4=conjg(amp4)
        endif
      endif

      if (htag < 0) then
c        write(6,*) 'ggZZcapture: no match found'
c        stop
        return
      endif

c      write(6,*) 'label',label
c      write(6,*) 'htag=',htag
c      write(6,*) 'ltag=',ltag
c      write(6,*) 'itag=',itag
c      pause 'got one'

c--- assign results
      res(htag,ltag,itag,imt0)=amp0
      res(htag,ltag,itag,imt2)=amp2
      res(htag,ltag,itag,imt4)=amp4

      if (abs(res(htag,ltag,itag,imt0)) < 1d-8)
     &    res(htag,ltag,itag,imt0)=czip
      if (abs(res(htag,ltag,itag,imt2)) < 1d-8)
     &    res(htag,ltag,itag,imt2)=czip
      if (abs(res(htag,ltag,itag,imt4)) < 1d-8)
     &    res(htag,ltag,itag,imt4)=czip

      return
      end

!! I will give you a C++ file which you will convert to a FORTRAN interface for

!!      to a FORTRAN module file. In order to do that I want you to replace, 
!!      ```
!!      #ifndef <MODULE-NAME>_MOD
!!      #define <MODULE-NAME>_MOD
!!      namespace <module-name> { 
!!      ...

!!      ...
!!      }
!!      #endif
!!      ```
!!      with a FORTRAN style,
!!      ```
!!      module <module-name>
!!        use, intrinsic :: iso_c_binding
!!        implicit none
!! 
!!        private
!!          ! private subroutines to bind with extern C functions
!!

!!          ! public variable pointers and init and finalize subroutines
!!

!!          subroutine <module-name>_init
!!            ! establish contracts with C++ data using bind C subroutines
!!          end subroutine <module-name_init
!! 
!!          subroutine <module-name>_finalize
!!            ! destroy contracts with C++ data, assign pointers to null
!!          end subroutine <module-name>_finalize
!! 
!!      end module <module-name>
!!      ```
!! 
!!   2. Combine `#include <module-name.hpp>`and `using namespace <module-name>` statement 
!!      with a `use <module-name>` statement and assume that any variables that are not
!!      declared in the file are available in the use module files. Follow FORTRAN syntax.
!! 
!!   3. Add bind C functions to an interface in the private section of the module to bind 
!!      with extern C functions in the C++ header file.
!! 
!!   4. Add `use, intrinsic :: iso_c_binding` and convert C++ variables to corresponding
!!      FORTRAN pointers. Convert variables declared as `const` to corresponding FORTRAN 
!!      parameters. For the latter treat `std::double` as `real(dp)` and `std::complex<double>` 
!!      as `complex(dp)` and include `use types` module. Adjust the syntax for correctness 
!!      and make the pointers and variables public.
!! 
!!   5. Note that C++ arrays with size `2*nf+1` should be mapped to a FORTRAN pointer array 
!!      ranging form `(-nf:nf)`. To do that you have to use a `temp_ptr` to first establish
!!      the contract using `c_f_pointer` and then do the mapping. For arrays with size `nf`
!!      use `temp_ptr` but map to FORTRAN with range `(1:nf)`
!! 
!!   5. Add `<module-name>_init` and `<module-name>_finalize` to the FORTRAN to establish
!!      and destroy contract with C++ data using `c_f_pointer` and bind C functions. 
!!      Make these subroutines public
!! 
!! I will give you a test problem once you tell me if you understand my requirements. 
!! 
!! LLM INSTRUCTIONS END

module ggZZ_mod
  use, intrinsic :: iso_c_binding
  use types
  implicit none

  private
    interface
      function get_ggZZuse6d() bind(C, name="ggZZ_mod_ggZZuse6d")
        import :: c_ptr, c_bool
        type(c_ptr) :: get_ggZZuse6d
      end function get_ggZZuse6d

      function get_res() bind(C, name="ggZZ_mod_res")
        import :: c_ptr, c_double_complex
        type(c_ptr) :: get_res
      end function get_res
    end interface

  public :: ggZZuse6d, res, ggZZ_mod_init, ggZZ_mod_finalize

  logical(c_bool), pointer :: ggZZuse6d => null()
  complex(c_double_complex), pointer, dimension(:,:,:,:) :: res => null()

contains
  subroutine ggZZ_mod_init()
    implicit none
    complex(c_double_complex), pointer, dimension(:,:,:,:) :: temp_ptr => null()
    !!write(*,*) "Initializing ggZZ_mod"
    call c_f_pointer(get_ggZZuse6d(), ggZZuse6d)

    allocate(res(1:2,1:4,1:10,1:3))
    call c_f_pointer(get_res(), temp_ptr, [2,4,10,3])
    res(1:2,1:4,1:10,1:3) = temp_ptr(1:2,1:4,1:10,1:3)
    temp_ptr => null()
  end subroutine ggZZ_mod_init

  subroutine ggZZ_mod_finalize()
    implicit none
    !!write(*,*) "Finalizing ggZZ_mod"
    ggZZuse6d => null()
    nullify(res)
  end subroutine ggZZ_mod_finalize

subroutine ggZZcapture(label,h34,h56,j1,j2,j3,j4,j5,j6,amp0,amp2,amp4)
  use, intrinsic :: iso_c_binding
  use ggZZ_mod

  implicit none

  ! ggZZ_mod's Fortran `res` is a separate allocation copied once out of the C++
  ! storage at init, not a c_f_pointer alias onto it, so it is passed to the
  ! wrapper explicitly: that is the array the Fortran readers of res observe.
  integer, parameter :: label_buf = 32

  character(len=*), intent(in) :: label
  integer(c_int), intent(in) :: h34, h56, j1, j2, j3, j4, j5, j6
  complex(c_double_complex), intent(inout) :: amp0, amp2, amp4

  character(kind=c_char), dimension(label_buf) :: clabel
  integer(c_int) :: label_len
  integer :: i, n

  interface
    subroutine ggZZcapture_wrapper(label,label_len,h34,h56,j1,j2,j3,j4,j5,j6, &
        amp0,amp2,amp4,res) bind(C, name="ggZZcapture_wrapper")
      import :: c_int, c_char, c_double_complex
      character(kind=c_char) :: label(*)
      integer(c_int), value :: label_len
      integer(c_int), value :: h34, h56, j1, j2, j3, j4, j5, j6
      complex(c_double_complex) :: amp0, amp2, amp4
      complex(c_double_complex) :: res(2,4,10,3)
    end subroutine ggZZcapture_wrapper
  end interface

  ! Blank-pad the character*(*) label into a fixed c_char buffer and pass its
  ! declared length alongside, so the C++ side can both trim() it and take the
  ! label(1:5)/label(6:6) substrings without running off the end.
  n = min(len(label), label_buf)
  do i = 1, label_buf
    if (i <= n) then
      clabel(i) = label(i:i)
    else
      clabel(i) = ' '
    end if
  end do
  label_len = int(n, c_int)

  call ggZZcapture_wrapper(clabel,label_len,h34,h56,j1,j2,j3,j4,j5,j6, &
                           amp0,amp2,amp4,res)
end subroutine ggZZcapture
EOF

"""Coverage check — decide VERIFIED vs TRANSLATED for one rewritten MCFM file.

  python3 coverage_check.py <target.cpp> -- <process args>

Builds and tests once, scales the marked output statement, rebuilds and retests, then
restores the file and rebuilds clean. Changed output means `COVERED`; unchanged output
means `NOT COVERED`.

Mark exactly one output statement with `// @coverage-probe`.
Needs `MCFM_HOME`. Exit: 0 covered, 1 not covered, 2 usage/setup error.
"""
import os, re, sys, shutil, tempfile, subprocess

FACTOR = os.environ.get("FACTOR", "1.5")


def die(msg):
    print(f"error: {msg}", file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(2)


def build(bin, mcfm):
    if not os.path.isfile(bin + "/CMakeCache.txt"):
        subprocess.run(["cmake",
                        "-DCMAKE_Fortran_COMPILER=" + os.environ.get("FC", "gfortran"),
                        "-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=" + os.environ.get("CC", "gcc"),
                        "-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=" + os.environ.get("CXX", "g++"),
                        "-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=" + mcfm + "/install",
                        "-S", mcfm, "-B", bin], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    subprocess.run(["make", "-C", bin, "install"], check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)


def run_test(bin, process):
    return subprocess.run([bin + "/test", "-b", *process], capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=bin).stdout


def main(argv):
    if not argv or argv[0] in ("-h", "--help"):
        die("usage: coverage_check.py <target.cpp> -- <process args>")
    target = argv[0]
    if len(argv) < 2 or argv[1] != "--":
        die("put the test process after --, e.g. -- u u~ e- e+")
    process = argv[2:]
    if not process:
        die("no test process given after --")

    mcfm = os.environ.get("MCFM_HOME") or die("set MCFM_HOME first (source environment.sh)")
    if not os.path.isfile(target):
        die("target file not found: " + target)
    text = open(target).read()
    if text.count("@coverage-probe") == 0:
        die(f"no '// @coverage-probe' marker in {target} — mark the statement that writes the main output")
    if text.count("@coverage-probe") != 1:
        die(f"found more than one '@coverage-probe' marker in {target} — keep exactly one")

    bin = mcfm + "/Bin"
    if not os.path.isdir(bin):
        die(f"no MCFM build dir at {bin} — build MCFM once first (jobrunner submit tests/mcfm)")

    snapshot = tempfile.mktemp()
    shutil.copy(target, snapshot)
